weeks.title: 5 things the UK is buying right now
10 more things the UK is buying this week

heated-throw.name: Heated throw, 160 x 130cm
heated-throw.blurb: The Amazon best seller. Ten heat settings, nine-hour timer, machine washable. A heated throw draws roughly 120 to 160 watts, so an evening on the sofa costs a few pence rather than putting the heating on.

lumie-sunrise-alarm.name: Lumie Sunrise Alarm
lumie-sunrise-alarm.blurb: The clocks go back on 25 October. A sunrise alarm brightens gradually for half an hour before the alarm, so you wake up in fake daylight instead of the dark. Lumie is the British brand that started the category.

karcher-wv1.name: Kärcher WV 1 window vac
karcher-wv1.blurb: Condensation season. Run it over the inside of the window in the morning and the water goes into the tank instead of down the wall and into the sealant. 20 minutes per charge, which does a whole house.

medicube-pdrn-balm.name: Medicube PDRN Collagen Volume Multi Balm Stick
medicube-pdrn-balm.blurb: The most-bought skincare product on Amazon UK right now and the number one best seller in eye balms. A balm stick for under-eyes, smile lines, neck and lips. Korean brand, went viral on TikTok in the summer and hasn't slowed down. Superdrug lists the same 10g stick at £25.

prices.note: #1 best seller in eye balms, 12% off RRP

prices.product: Medicube PDRN Pink Collagen Volume Multi Balm 10g
prices.note: Not available online when checked; Superdrug price last checked 12 October

shark-flexstyle.name: Shark FlexStyle 5-in-1 Air Styler and Hair Dryer
shark-flexstyle.blurb: The Dyson Airwrap alternative. Dries, curls with auto-wrap barrels, and has the oval brush and concentrator. Was £269.99 to £299.99 depending on the kit. Argos had it at £229.99 when we checked on 11 October, and Amazon has since gone back up to £259.98, so check Argos first.

oral-b-io2-duo.name: Oral-B iO2 Duo electric toothbrushes (2 handles, Night Black and Calm Pink)
oral-b-io2-duo.blurb: Two Oral-B iO2 electric toothbrushes in one box, with two heads, a travel case and a refill holder. Pressure sensor, two minute timer and three quiet intensity settings, designed by Braun. Amazon has it on a limited time deal at £59.98 against a £160 RRP, while Boots lists the same Night Black and Calm Pink duo pack at £70 and Argos at £65.

prices.note: Limited time deal, 63% off RRP, sold by Amazon

prices.product: Oral-B iO2 Electric Toothbrush Night Black and Calm Pink Duo Pack
prices.note: Better than half price offer, in stock online; Boots price last checked 14 October

prices.product: Oral-B iO2 Duo Pack Electric Toothbrush Night Black/Pink

medicube-zero-pore-pads.name: Medicube Zero Pore Pad 2.0 toner pads (70 pads)
medicube-zero-pore-pads.blurb: The number one best seller in Amazon UK's whole beauty category, with 100,000 bought in the past month. Seventy dual textured toner pads with lactic and salicylic acid that you swipe over the face after cleansing to clear pores and smooth texture. Superdrug lists the same 70 pad tub at £17.89.

prices.note: #1 best seller in beauty, 9% off RRP

maybelline-sky-high-mascara.name: Maybelline Lash Sensational Sky High mascara, black
maybelline-sky-high-mascara.blurb: The mascara TikTok made famous, with a flexible bamboo extract wand that lengthens without clumping or flaking. 60,000 people bought it on Amazon in the past month and it is number two in beauty. Superdrug sells the same black 7.2ml tube at £12.99, so Amazon is close to half price.

prices.product: Maybelline Lash Sensational Sky High Mascara 01 Black

garnier-micellar-water-700ml.name: Garnier Micellar Cleansing Water, 700ml
garnier-micellar-water-700ml.blurb: The big 700ml bottle of the UK's best selling micellar water, which takes off make up and cleanses without rinsing and suits sensitive skin. 70,000 people bought it on Amazon in the past month. Superdrug has a third off its £9.99 price this week, and Amazon is still a little cheaper.

prices.note: Save a third on selected Garnier skincare

cerave-hydrating-cleanser.name: CeraVe Hydrating Cleanser for normal to dry skin, 236ml
cerave-hydrating-cleanser.blurb: The dermatologist favourite for normal to dry skin, with three ceramides and hyaluronic acid and no foaming agents to strip the skin. The 236ml pump bottle lasts for months, and 30,000 people bought one on Amazon in the past month. Superdrug lists the same bottle at £12.49.

prices.product: CeraVe Hydrating Cleanser with Hyaluronic Acid for Dry Skin 236ml
prices.note: Buy one get second half price on selected CeraVe

biodance-collagen-mask.name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep overnight mask (4 sheets)
biodance-collagen-mask.blurb: The viral overnight hydrogel mask that goes on cloudy and turns clear as the collagen soaks in over three to four hours. A box of four sheets, and 40,000 people bought it on Amazon in the past month. Superdrug has the same four pack at £14.89.

prices.product: Biodance Bio Collagen Real Deep Mask 34g 4pk

brita-maxtra-pro-6-pack.name: BRITA MAXTRA PRO Pure Performance filter cartridges, 6 pack
brita-maxtra-pro-6-pack.blurb: Six genuine BRITA MAXTRA PRO cartridges, which is six months of filtered water in any current BRITA jug. 20,000 people bought this pack on Amazon in the past month. Currys lists the same six pack at £34.99, more than £10 dearer.

prices.product: BRITA MAXTRA PRO 1053089 Water Filter Cartridge, pack of 6

oral-b-vitality-pro.name: Oral-B Vitality Pro electric toothbrush, black (2 heads)
oral-b-vitality-pro.blurb: Oral-B's entry level rechargeable toothbrush, with a two minute timer, three brushing modes including sensitive and two round heads in the box. It is the number one best seller in rotating toothbrushes on Amazon, with 10,000 bought in the past month. Currys has the same black Vitality Pro at £29.99.

prices.note: 58% off RRP, #1 best seller in rotating toothbrushes

prices.product: ORAL-B Vitality Pro Electric Toothbrush, Black

maybelline-eraser-concealer.name: Maybelline Instant Anti Age Eraser eye concealer, 01 Light
maybelline-eraser-concealer.blurb: The sponge tip concealer for dark circles that has sat in the best seller lists for over a decade, in shade 01 Light. 10,000 people bought it on Amazon in the past month. Superdrug has it on offer at £7.99, down from £9.99, and Amazon is a pound cheaper again.

prices.product: Maybelline Instant Anti Age Eraser Eye Concealer (Light)
prices.note: Save 20% on selected Maybelline face make up, online only

nizoral-shampoo-60ml.name: Nizoral Anti-Dandruff Shampoo, 60ml
nizoral-shampoo-60ml.blurb: The pharmacy strength anti dandruff shampoo with 2% ketoconazole, used twice a week to clear flakes and then once a fortnight to keep them away. 40,000 people bought it on Amazon in the past month. Superdrug sells the same 60ml bottle at £8.49.

dreo-atom-316-heater.name: Dreo Atom 316 1500W ceramic fan heater with remote
dreo-atom-316-heater.blurb: A 1500W ceramic fan heater with a remote, a 12 hour timer and a thermostat that switches it off once the room is warm, so it heats one room instead of the whole house. 5,000 people bought one on Amazon in the past month. Amazon has it on a deal that ends tonight; no high street price could be checked for this exact model, so this one is a was and now deal.

prices.note: Deal ends tonight, 15 October, at about 11.45pm UK time, while promotional stock lasts
